title: kaya record gates: hooks, CI parity, record-lag
description:
Part of funkalization-034 (adopt kaya), blocked-by the bootstrap child. Outcome: the ledger stays in sync mechanically — `kaya check` green in CI.

## Steps

1. Record gates as pre-commit/pre-push hooks using this repo's existing hook manager (lefthook / ddl gates — follow repo convention, no new mechanism).
2. CI: `kaya check` step + `record-lag` bound 60 commits (pattern: charly-vibes/kaya scripts/record-lag.py @ v0.4.1). Scheduled snapshot workflow must `git pull --rebase` then push in a retry loop — a bare cron `git push` raced interactive pushes in the kaya repo and forced two rebases during its v0.3.0.
3. Regression suite: this repo's existing pipeline (its `just ci` / ci.yml) stays green with the gates added.

## Must gate

CI green with `kaya check` + `record-lag` active; corrupting the ledger (delete an event, rebuild stale) fails the gate.

## Meter

- two consecutive green CI runs on the gate PR
- a deliberately stale ledger fails `record-lag` (negative test)

## Anti-goals

- No bypass env vars or path exclusions that silence the gate.
- No scheduled push without the rebase-retry loop.

title: kaya publication: generated dossier in docs + link check
description:
Part of funkalization-034 (adopt kaya), blocked-by the gates child. Outcome: generated research dossier in this repo's docs, built from the ledger.

## Steps

1. `kaya publish` output lands in docs/ under the document taxonomy (research map, brief, understanding, overview — pattern: charly-vibes/kaya docs/src @ v0.4.1).
2. Link check walks the generated tree (pattern: charly-vibes/kaya scripts/check-links.py @ v0.4.1).
3. The repo's existing docs build includes the generated pages.

## Must gate

Docs build succeeds with generated pages present; link check exits 0.

## Meter

- clean-tree `kaya build` twice → identical `.kaya/build-state.json` `content_hash` (digest-stable)
- generated files are build outputs, not tracked hand-edits

## Anti-goals

- No hand-edits to generated files.
- No per-repo renderer forks.

title: kaya SSOT cutover: versions.ddl.toml pin + duplicate-doc retirement
description:
Part of funkalization-034 (adopt kaya), blocked-by the publication child. Outcome: kaya pinned per fleet convention; duplicate hand-maintained docs retired.

## Steps

1. Pin `kaya = "0.4.1"` in `versions.ddl.toml` (§4 convention: installs pinned, never `latest`).
2. Take the bootstrap child's inventory: enumerate hand-maintained docs duplicating ledger projections; retire or replace each with generated output. Every inventory item gets an explicit disposition (retired / kept with reason).
3. Point the repo README/docs at the record workflow.

## Must gate

`versions.ddl.toml` contains the pin; inventory list fully dispositioned (zero unexamined duplicates).

## Meter

- `ddl doctor` / repo conformance check passes with the pin
- disposition list complete in this ticket

## Anti-goals

- No `latest` installs.
- No retiring docs that carry non-record content without migrating it first.

title: Bootstrap kaya record: inventory, seed, capture recipe, kaya check green locally
description:
Part of funkalization-034 (adopt kaya). Thin vertical slice: when this closes, the repo's research record exists as a kaya ledger and `kaya check` is green locally.

## Steps

1. Inventory the surfaces kaya will import — `openspec/changes/`, `.wai/projects/funkalization/`, `docs/`, plus anything repo-specific. Some may not exist; adapt the import set to what is present, never force.
2. `kaya init`; seed the model from the inventory: Question -investigates-> Experiment, Hypothesis -predicts-> Experiment, Model -realizes-> Hypothesis; Sources pinned `path@commit` (pattern: charly-vibes/kaya `.kaya/seeds/*.jsonl` @ v0.4.1).
3. Wire the capture recipe: `kaya import wai` + `kaya import git` (exclude `chore(record):` commits) + `kaya build`, serialized under `.kaya/capture.lock`, skipped on dirty tree (pattern: charly-vibes/kaya justfile:record-capture @ v0.4.1).
4. Import, build, commit `.kaya/ledger.jsonl`.

## Must gate

`kaya check` exits 0 on the committed record.

## Meter

- `kaya check`
- every step-1 inventoried surface path appears as a Source event in the ledger (grep ledger / `kaya status`)

## Anti-goals

- No seed-only ledger that skips importing a surface the inventory found.
- No hand-edited projections (generated docs are build outputs).

## Lane

Design/HITL: which Question/Hypothesis/Experiment define this repo is a judgment call — confirm the seed model with charly before committing the ledger.

title: Adopt kaya: research record as the single source of truth
description:
## Why

kaya compiles the artifacts a repo already produces (openspec changes, wai designs, git history) into an append-only event ledger (`.kaya/ledger.jsonl`, schema `kaya.event/v0`) and generates human-owned docs as projections (research map, brief, understanding, overview, handoff). Adopting it makes this repo's research/design/decision record event-sourced and verifiable instead of hand-maintained. Reference implementation: charly-vibes/kaya, dogfooded on itself since v0.1.0; all recipe/pattern citations below are pinned to tag **v0.4.1**.

## Children (execute in order; each child is a closed ticket + commit boundary)

1. funkalization-034.1 — Bootstrap: inventory, seed, capture recipe, `kaya check` green locally
2. funkalization-034.5 — Gates: hooks, CI parity, record-lag (blocked-by funkalization-034.1)
3. funkalization-034.6 — Publication: generated dossier in docs + link check (blocked-by funkalization-034.5)
4. funkalization-034.7 — SSOT cutover: `versions.ddl.toml` pin + duplicate-doc retirement (blocked-by funkalization-034.6)

This epic is a decomposition container (complexity:xl): never claim it whole — claim a child.

## Must gates (epic exit criteria)

- `kaya check` green locally and in CI; `.kaya/ledger.jsonl` committed.
- Idempotence meter: clean-tree `kaya build` twice → identical `.kaya/build-state.json` `content_hash`.
- `record-lag` green at bound 60 commits (pattern: charly-vibes/kaya scripts/record-lag.py @ v0.4.1).
- Coverage meter (the SSOT claim): every surface from the child-1 inventory (`openspec/changes/`, `.wai/projects/funkalization/` where present) appears as a Source event; the inventory is fully dispositioned in child 4.
- Scheduled snapshot workflow yields to interactive pushes: `git pull --rebase` + retry (lesson from the kaya repo: a bare cron `git push` forced two rebases during its v0.3.0).

description: Follow the research ticket's scratchbook. Add hegeltest = "=0.52.7" with features = ["static-engine"] as a dev-dependency; add .hegel/ to .gitignore. title: Research: Hegel property-based testing plan (antithesis-research)
description:
Run the Antithesis research skill (antithesis-research) on this repo before any test code is written. Scope: the pure core in src/model.rs (reduce, evaluate, view/gate) and the ledger persistence layer.

Deliverable: antithesis/scratchbook/{sut-analysis,existing-assertions,property-catalog,property-relationships}.md plus per-property evidence files, following the skill's format. For each candidate property record: exact invariant, check mode (pure fn / tempdir / subprocess), public API or test seam needed, generator sketch, and whether it is expected red or green today. Baseline candidates from the suite evaluation: (1) lifecycle transition soundness over the typed Action enum, (2) no-vacuous-PASS and minimal witness in evaluate, (3) append-only ledger + replay exactness, (4) view-gate agrees with reduce on proposed proposals.

Also decide: Hegel applicability, test file layout, state-machine shape for (1)/(3), and CI invocation (pinned hegeltest 0.52.7 with static-engine). Do not change production code or tests in this ticket. Suite context: reports/hegel-eval-2026-11-16/README.md in the charly superproject.
acceptance_criteria: Scratchbook artifacts exist with per-property evidence; each property has invariant, check mode, seam/generator plan, and predicted red/green; recommendation states whether/how to use Hegel here; no code changes.
notes: Method: run the antithesis-research skill from https://github.com/antithesishq/antithesis-skills (read the skill before starting). Engine under evaluation: https://hegel.dev/ (crate hegeltest 0.52.7). Suite evaluation and property baseline: reports/hegel-eval-2026-11-16/README.md and antithesis/scratchbook/property-catalog.md in the charly superproject.

title: docs: apply README front-door standard v0.4 (§5.1)
description:
Standard (authoritative, mandatory (ddl-managed)): https://github.com/charly-vibes/dulce-de-leche/blob/main/docs/standardization.md#51-readme-front-door-contract

Audit (2026-11-15): 5/10. Broken design link and no decision guidance.

Repo-specific gaps:
- `funkalization/README.md:31` links `openspec/changes/add-persistent-tracer/design.md`; the actual path is `openspec/changes/archive/2026-10-16-add-persistent-tracer/design.md`.
- No when-to-use vs `specodelic` (spec format/verification) or `wai` (session workflow).
- No FAQ for tracer vs the proposed workspace, or the disabled source write-back.

Required changes:
- [ ] Add `## When to use` with use bullets, 'use <sibling> instead' bullets, and the assumption the tool makes.
- [ ] Make `## Quick start` install → first meaningful command → expected output.
- [ ] Ensure `docs/src/faq.md` or `docs/src/troubleshooting.md` exists and link it from the README first screen (an inline README-only FAQ does not satisfy §5.1).
- [ ] Move repository-development recipes (`just …`, build-from-source) to `## Development`.
- [ ] Fix broken relative README links (if any).
- [ ] Fix the archived design link.



Context: fleet README audit 2026-11-15 (45 repos); umbrella epic `charly-o1j`.

## Sibling alternatives
`specodelic` for the spec format, `wai` for session reasoning, OpenSpec for change management.

## Scope notes
FAQ requirement: §5.1 requires `docs/src/faq.md` or `docs/src/troubleshooting.md`; an inline README-only FAQ does not close it.

## Acceptance (Meter)
README contains `## When to use` (named alternative or explicit "no sibling"), `## Quick start` with an expected result, and a FAQ/troubleshooting link. `docs/src/faq.md` or `docs/src/troubleshooting.md` exists and is linked. `rg -n "^## (When to use|Quick start|FAQ)" README.md` exits 0; the repo link check exits 0; every documented command exists in `--help`; `just ci` stays green.

## Anti-goals
Anti-goals: do not change tool behavior; do not invent commands, flags, or features; do not delete or weaken existing docs or gates; do not rewrite unrelated sections; do not claim unavailable functionality. Do not replace the required docs FAQ/troubleshooting page with an inline README-only FAQ.

## Coordination
Coordination: funkalization-frc and funkalization-3d5 both edit README/status; schedule together.
